subject: The 3AM hack that power users never share
preview_text: One tap reveals what most people miss. Here's the shortcut that changed how I scan conversations.
body_paragraphs: I scanned a text from my ex at 3AM. The app flagged gaslighting — but I already knew that. What I didn't know was the one move that turns a single screenshot into a pattern map across weeks. Power users call it the 'shadow scan.' It's not in the tutorial.

Here's the shortcut: after you scan a conversation, swipe left on the toxicity score. It pulls up a hidden timeline that links every red flag you've ever scanned from that person — love bombing, manipulation, the quiet jabs. Most people stop at the score. The masters go one step deeper.

This is the difference between spotting one red flag and seeing the entire pattern. Open your app, scan any conversation, then swipe left on the score. Watch how the timeline connects dots you didn't know existed. It's like having a detective on speed dial.
Try it now: scan one text and swipe left. P.S. — That 3AM scan? It saved me three months of doubt. Your gut already knows. This shortcut just confirms it.
